hints.title: Contiguous Identical Run Detection
hints.text: A large group contains 3 or more consecutive identical characters. Identify boundaries [start, end] for every uniform character run.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Segment Scanning
hints.text: Track the start index of the current run. Advance end pointer until s[end] differs from s[start] or end reaches string length.

hints.title: Length Threshold Interval Collection
hints.text: If end minus start is at least 3, append [start, end - 1] to the results. Then update start to end and continue.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating substrings or regular expressions adds regex overhead compared to a single linear scan.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single two-pointer linear traversal records intervals in O(N) time with O(1) memory beyond output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the trailing end-of-string boundary cleanly.
